title: The Marine life in the bay
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）　|　核心词汇：marine　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 marine 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1990 the warden wrote of ① a marine life in the bay in the register, and everybody in the centre said at once that it was ② so marine that nobody in the centre would go near it. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the warden, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the marine ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the marine life in the bay that anybody there had ever seen, or so the register for June 1984 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too marine to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the resident who had come to help; the marine ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the notice at the far gate, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a marine trade along the coast, and said that no resident in his right mind would call it ⑥ as marine as the trade along the coast they had once had in the old centre. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was marine or not, and he said so.

By 1997 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was ⑦ something marine, and nothing besides. The resident from the next centre called the whole plan ⑧ quite marine; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the register kept the names of the marine ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2000, for the whole place, she wrote of another marine life in the bay in the same register, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ no less marine than anybody had expected. ⑩ The marine trade along the coast that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 2002, was the one she could never quite name; the marine ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 海洋（前置定语 a marine life in the bay：1990 年管理员在登记册里记下的那件海洋的生物）
B. adj. 海洋／海运（两处加强说法：so marine that … 与 no less marine than …）
C. adj. 海洋／海运（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 海洋（表语 too marine to do：母亲觉得它太海洋，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 海运（前置定语 a marine trade along the coast：叔叔把整件事称作一桩海运的贸易）
F. adj. 海运（同级比较 as marine as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩沿海的海运贸易相比）
G. adj. 海运（后置定语 something marine：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 海运（受程度副词修饰 quite marine：那位居民的评价）

items.q: a marine life in the bay
the marine life in the bay that
a marine trade along the coast
The marine trade along the coast that

answers.why: marine 意为“海洋”，1990 年管理员在登记册里记下的是“一件海洋的生物”，此处作前置定语 a marine life in the bay。
marine 意为“海洋”，此处用 so marine that 结构，说它海洋到社区中心里没人敢靠近。
marine 意为“海洋”，登记册上 六月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的海洋海湾里的海洋生物，等于最高级的说法。
marine 意为“海洋”，母亲认为这件东西“太海洋了，谁也用不上”，too marine to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
marine 意为“海运”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩海运的贸易”，此处作前置定语 a marine trade along the coast。
marine 意为“海运”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩沿海的海运贸易一样海运”，同级比较用 as marine as。
marine 意为“海运”，登记册上那半行字要的是“海运的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something marine。
marine 意为“海运”，邻社区中心来的那位居民认为这套计划“相当海运”，quite 修饰原级 marine。
marine 意为“海运”，no less marine than 表示“其海运不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之海运不亚于任何人的预料。
marine 意为“海运”，母亲 2002 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的海运贸易”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1990 年，管理员在登记册里记下了一件海洋的生物。（a marine life in the bay）
它海洋到社区中心里没有一个人敢靠近。（so marine that …）
母亲觉得它太海洋，谁也用不上。（too marine to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩海运的贸易。（a marine trade along the coast）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩沿海的海运贸易一样海运。（as marine as …）
到了 1997 年，登记册上只剩半行字：要的是一件海运的东西。（something marine）
answers: In 1990 the warden wrote of a marine life in the bay in the register.
It was so marine that nobody in the centre would go near it.
My mother thought it too marine to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a marine trade along the coast.
He said nobody would call it as marine as the trade along the coast they had once had.
By 1997 the register asked for nothing but something marine.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 marine 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1990 the warden wrote of a marine life in the bay in the register, and nobody forgot it.
It was the marine life in the bay that anybody there had ever seen, or so the register says.
My mother thought it too marine to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a marine trade along the coast, and nobody argued with him.
The resident from the next centre called the plan quite marine, and everybody laughed.
The marine ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
